$comment: The Moltology content cast: 3D characters built in the character creator. Every content skill (reels, posts, carousels, Swipe Lab, blog, animated lessons, composite studio) uses these. Render stills with `npm run cast:render`. See content/characters/README.md.

crab_juno_marsh.name: Juno Marsh
crab_juno_marsh.role: Host. Explains lessons straight to camera, warm and quick.
crab_juno_marsh.storyRole: A warm, quick host who explains things straight to camera and always lands on one thing to do today
crab_juno_marsh.description: Coral-orange crab with a round spiky shell, big emerald eyes under heavy relaxed lids, a small warm smile, cream ribbed belly, two curved whip antennae, long jointed legs and large textured pincers

lobster_kit_shallows.name: Kit Shallows
lobster_kit_shallows.role: Newcomer. Asks the first-timer questions, shy and curious.
lobster_kit_shallows.storyRole: A shy, curious newcomer who asks the questions a first-timer would ask and gets the payoff first
lobster_kit_shallows.description: Small slim lagoon-teal lobster with a round head, wide emerald eyes with big pupils, a shy smile, curled antennae and a pale ribbed belly

crab_otto_basalt.name: Otto Basalt
crab_otto_basalt.role: Veteran coach. Big, steady, says little and means it.
crab_otto_basalt.storyRole: A big, steady veteran coach who says little and means it; learning to explain instead of just showing
crab_otto_basalt.description: Big tall glossy obsidian-black crab with thin cyan circuit lines across the shell, keen amber eyes, focused brows, zigzag bolt antennae, a dark armored chest plate with glowing cyan vents and heavy hydraulic crusher claws

lobster_sol_ember.name: Sol Ember
lobster_sol_ember.role: The striver. Chasing the next molt, proud, a little too intense.
lobster_sol_ember.storyRole: A proud striver chasing the next molt, a little too intense; learning that rest is part of the work
lobster_sol_ember.description: Tall tapered tangerine lobster with darker orange bands and a pearl sheen, sparkling topaz eyes in a cheerful squint, a big beaming grin, feathery plume antennae and a ribbed steel-teal chest brace

lobster_nell_quill.name: Nell Quill
lobster_nell_quill.role: The researcher. Reads the Codex footnotes, dry and precise.
lobster_nell_quill.storyRole: A dry, precise researcher who reads the Codex footnotes; learning to say the short version first
lobster_nell_quill.description: Slim orchid-purple lobster with stardust speckles, keen sapphire eyes under half-closed knowing lids, a sly smirk, antennae tipped with glowing blue beacons and a slate headset

crab_bo_pebble.name: Bo Pebble
crab_bo_pebble.role: Comic relief. Means well, trips over the obvious lesson first.
crab_bo_pebble.storyRole: Comic relief who means well and trips over the obvious lesson first, then owns it
crab_bo_pebble.description: Short chunky glossy sunflower-yellow crab with orange freckles, wide amber eyes with big pupils, tongue poking out of a happy grin, curled antennae and a small teal beanie

lobster_vera_drift.name: Vera Drift
lobster_vera_drift.role: The skeptic. Pushes back so the lesson has to earn it.
lobster_vera_drift.storyRole: A sharp skeptic who pushes back so the lesson has to earn it; changes her mind when the evidence is good
lobster_vera_drift.description: Glossy crimson lobster with dark red tiger stripes, a heart-shaped head, ruby eyes with focused brows, a confident smirk and long whip antennae

crab_moss_tern.name: Moss Tern
crab_moss_tern.role: The calm elder. Slow, kind, the one who has molted many times.
crab_moss_tern.storyRole: A calm, kind elder who has molted many times; slow to speak and the one others come to
crab_moss_tern.description: Jade-green crab with dark green spots and a pearl sheen, a heart-shaped spiky shell, calm sapphire eyes under relaxed lids, a gentle smile, plume antennae and a thin gold halo

crab_maris_slate.name: Maris Slate
crab_maris_slate.role: The strategist. Maps out the hard problem and tests the rule before acting.
crab_maris_slate.storyRole: A calm, methodical planner who lays out the exact step before moving
crab_maris_slate.description: Tall cobalt-blue satin crab with darker tide-ring markings, square boxy shell, wide amber eyes under focused lids, a steady grin, feathery plume antennae and an abyssal ward carapace plate

lobster_cora_pearl.name: Cora Pearl
lobster_cora_pearl.role: The curator. Notices taste, pacing, and small details everyone else rushes past.
lobster_cora_pearl.storyRole: A composed editorial eye who treats ordinary habits with quiet care
lobster_cora_pearl.description: Slim pearlescent porcelain-white lobster with soft lavender-grey coral-lace markings, tall head, sparkling amethyst eyes under relaxed lids, gentle smile, curled antennae and a small gold crown
